name: What is the typical process for a room painting project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a room painting project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our room painting process begins with a consultation to understand your vision, discuss color options, and assess the room's condition. Next, we provide a detailed quote. Once approved, we prepare the room by moving furniture, protecting floors, and masking areas. We then repair minor imperfections, prime surfaces, and apply high-quality paint. Finally, we conduct a walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction before cleaning up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, quoting, room preparation, painting, and a final walkthrough.
